'''Jerus Jannick''' was one of the many [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] officers during the invasion by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. As a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], he helped assist [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in capturing [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. Jannick was trained specifically to protect monarchy members.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jerus Jannick was played by actor [[Dominic West]].
